entries.name: Boomer
entries.restore_how: PMW 프로필 신규 + 구매 목록 [WarriorN]
entries.text: Raised on an isolated Periphery world, Boomer's dialect is more than difficult to understand. Fortunately, he lets his `Mech do most of the talking.

entries.name: Detox
entries.restore_how: PMW 프로필 신규 + 구매 목록 [WarriorN]
entries.text: You won't find this MechWarrior in the barracks- Detox's `Mech is his home. Unfortunately, that means the cleaning crews get hazard pay...

entries.name: Ghost
entries.restore_how: PMW 프로필 신규 + 구매 목록 [WarriorN]
entries.text: Quiet and aloof without tons of hardened metal around her, Ghost comes alive on the battlefield. Even then, however, she's one of the more reserved in the unit.

entries.name: Jinx
entries.restore_how: PMW 프로필 신규 + 구매 목록 [WarriorN]
entries.text: Her nickname comes not from the effect she has on teammates, but on the bad luck that seems to fall on the enemy when she's around.

entries.name: Needle
entries.restore_how: PMW 프로필 신규 + 구매 목록 [WarriorN]
entries.text: A military brat, Needle knows nothing but military life. But, unlike her siblings, she has no intention or pursuing promotion. She prefers the trenches.

entries.name: Pyro
entries.restore_how: PMW 프로필 신규 + 구매 목록 [WarriorN]
entries.text: Pyro earned his name for reasons you can well imagine. His obsession, however, aptly conceals a sharp military mind and professional warrior.

entries.name: Sponge
entries.restore_how: PMW 프로필 신규 + 구매 목록 [WarriorN]
entries.text: Sponge owns nothing that he did not beg, borrow, or steal from someone. Even his callsign, believe it or not, is lifted from someone in the Wolf Dragoons.

entries.name: Squid
entries.restore_how: PMW 프로필 신규 + 구매 목록 [WarriorN]
entries.text: Squid's callsign is a holdover from his days as a green MechWarrior. A rookie no longer, Squid is looking forward to testing his mettle against the Clans.

entries.name: Toad
entries.restore_how: PMW 프로필 신규 + 구매 목록 [WarriorN]
entries.text: The veteran Toad is even grumpier out of the cockpit than in. To that end, his superiors try and assign him to picket duty whenever practical.

entries.name: Vandal
entries.restore_how: PMW 프로필 신규 + 구매 목록 [WarriorN]
entries.text: To many, it seems amazing that Vandal has lived as long as he has. If there is a risk to be taken on the battlefield, he charges to it.

entries.name: Wasp
entries.restore_how: PMW 프로필 신규 + 구매 목록 [WarriorN]
entries.text: Wasp loves recon work, the lighter and faster the `Mech the better. Fortunately, few can pilot a speeding 25-ton piece of metal as she can.
